verdict.rationale: Docs show monday supports connecting to external providers (Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, Make, Claude, ChatGPT, OpenAI/Anthropic/Google) and a code-first apps framework for building custom integrations, implying an ecosystem/marketplace exists, but no evidence explicitly describes a marketplace with 'thousands' of third-party apps or lists its scale/catalog. missing for 10: explicit marketplace/app-store evidence, count or breadth of third-party integrations, independent confirmation of marketplace usage.
